leads.summary: InCred Finance is a lending company offering personal, education, business and MSME loans, describing itself as a technology and data science driven financial services platform.
leads.hook: Their site offers a free credit-score check and a 'Check Your Credit Score / Unlock Digital Credit Eligibility' flow, and the InCred GitHub org's code is in Kotlin.
leads.angle_reason: Their lending platform handles personal financial data and eligibility checks, the same kind of per-user data isolation and JWT auth work MedVault does in Django.

leads.summary: WisdmLabs is a WordPress agency that builds and optimizes WooCommerce, LearnDash and WordPress sites for businesses, and also sells performance, SEO and AI-automation services.
leads.hook: Their LearnDash case study says lesson loads got faster and logged-in lag was removed after they rebuilt performance around real user behaviour.
leads.angle_reason: Their AI automation service (content ops, lead routing) is LLM workflow work, like MedVault's schema-constrained Gemini pipeline.

leads.summary: BatBin is a small open-source pastebin for sharing code that generates link previews when a paste is shared on social media.
leads.hook: The project is a pastebin that generates previews for when a link is shared on social media, and its repos are tagged for Hacktoberfest.
leads.angle_reason: BatBin is a code-sharing web tool built around a shared link; Canopy is also built around turning a shared repo link into an analyzed view.

leads.summary: Osmos is a retail media platform for retailers and marketplaces, covering onsite and offsite ad products, measurement, and AI agents that plan and optimize campaigns.
leads.hook: Their Sofie AI agents (Report Writer, Insights Analyst, Media Planner) are described as seven specialist agents that analyze, plan, create and optimize campaigns.
leads.angle_reason: Their Sofie AI agents produce structured campaign output, the same kind of LLM pipeline with a fixed output schema that MedVault runs.

leads.summary: HackSlash is a student developer club at NIT Patna with 100+ members, organized into teams for web, Flutter, Kotlin, AI/ML, blockchain and DSA that run collaborative projects and events.
leads.hook: Their Teams page lists separate Flutter, Kotlin, AI/ML, blockchain and DSA teams under a 100+ member student club.
leads.angle_reason: Their AI/ML team is the closest match; MedVault is an LLM app with a schema-constrained output pipeline.

leads.summary: The Centre for Networked Intelligence at IISc Bangalore is a research centre that runs seminars, workshops and summer schools on networks, learning and optimization, and publishes a city-scale simulator.
leads.hook: Their repo topics include city-scale-simulator and simulator-workflow, alongside a seminar series on networked systems.
leads.angle_reason: Their city-scale simulator is graph-heavy C++ code; Canopy's cross-file call-graph resolution is the nearest work to that kind of graph analysis.

leads.summary: RoboVITics is the official robotics club of VIT Vellore, running free workshops, the Hands On Robotics course, and the RoboWars competition.
leads.hook: Their Hands On Robotics workshop teaches students to build Arduino line-follower and obstacle-avoider robots, and their VORTEX360 hackathon runs on Autodesk Fusion 360.
leads.angle_reason: No real overlap with robotics work; Canopy is the nearest web app in the candidate's work.
